company_description:
Halden Pay is a financial technology company providing business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance to exporters.

Its stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues across teams, taking responsibility for problems and learning from them, and reducing complexity to move quickly for clients. The company describes a collaborative environment with clear career paths, annual learning budgets and mentoring in every department.

Most offices operate a hybrid model, with three days a week in the office. Engineering teams are organised around payments, risk, data platforms and client experience. Regular team events help build connections across approximately 40 offices.

Employee reviews describe a commercially driven culture with friendly colleagues, though some say onboarding and training vary considerably between teams.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
